rationale: This is a cosmetic recombination of two already-tested legs (working_capital_buffer_vs_dependence and earnings_based_wall_coverage) under an identical weight, and its stated rationale is factually shaky since wcap does absorb retained cash profits, so the two "non-overlapping" resources are in fact substantially correlated.

A defensible pillar substitution inside the MAX weakest-link form whose sign and construction are internally consistent, though it is a one-input swap on an already-evaluated signal and therefore only modestly informative.

Holding the informative legs fixed and swapping the conditioner from leverage level to maturity urgency is a clean, economically motivated test of the mechanism's timing channel, but it remains a single-term variation on an existing signal and dlc/lt overlaps with the previously tested dlc/lct weight.

The signal leg RANK(oancf/lct) − RANK(ib/lct) is a scaled accruals measure, so this is largely a rediscovery of the Sloan accruals anomaly (and its documented interaction with external financing in Bradshaw–Richardson–Sloan), dressed in a funding-access narrative.

Internally consistent and a genuine specification question about whether obligations or inflow dependence is the right opposing leg, but the dvt+prstkc component pulls against the well-documented payout-yield effect and dltr scales with debt level, so any result will be hard to attribute cleanly.

The hypothesis rests on cash taxes being immune to accrual management, but txt is accrual-based total tax expense (not txpd), so the construct does not match the stated mechanism; it also reduces to yet another profitability proxy in a mechanical sweep whose alpha is likely absorbed by RMW.
